content.summary: Executed repairs for three failures from P1 attempt 01; the invalid calendar date was a runtime defect while two failures exposed fixture setup errors.
findings: jsonschema's optional date format dependency is absent in the locked environment; pattern matching alone admitted February 31.
The dependency test accidentally replaced a source under an existing key, correctly exercising the stale-source veto instead of adjudication.
The master recovery fixture moved OUT outside ROOT without relocating ROOT.
changes: Validate every contract date-time using the existing strict timestamp parser in addition to schema validation.
Give the dependency fixture a distinct source identity.
Relocate the master fixture root and supply stable synthetic inputs, preserving production path restrictions.
regression: Missing dependency cannot be adjudicated away.
Interrupted attempt retained and inherited by refreshed successor plan.

content.summary: Repaired the progress diagnostic exposed by the actual automatic-repair scenario and narrowed it to resolved discrepancies, so new error records cannot falsely count as progress.
findings: The controller passed Python tuples into canonical JSON hashing, which correctly rejected them.
The same diagnostic would have counted newly raised issues as progress; the intended criterion is an existing uncertainty actually resolved.
changes: Compare sets of resolved issue identities directly, and reset no-progress only for a newly resolved issue.
regression: Execute the scripted omission repair end to end and require preserved blind candidates, resolved structural omission and a still-blocked Java/meaning outcome.
Rerun all P1 and P2 cases including last-slot race, crash recovery and stale fences.

content.summary: Repaired the actual Java host harness failure from the first P4 run, and applied additional review findings on breadth reservation, deterministic scheduling and successor uncertainty before repeating whole-round acceptance.
findings: 201 regression tests, contract regeneration and conformance passed. The separately compiled caller failed because the harness sent mode historical, while the public Java contract accepts replay. Direct reproduction produced Json.Invalid and inspection confirmed the accepted modes.

Candidate caps retained minorities but could consume all active slots on repeated majority proposals. Initial collection now reserves available slots for unseen declared families; deferred proposals remain visible and block clean reporting.
Equal-priority issue scheduling used random identifiers rather than creation order. Stable sorting now preserves database creation order.

A successor investigation could previously omit the predecessor's unresolved questions. Creation now carries them with the original root and issue hash; reviewed supersession checks that every inherited question has actually been resolved.
Argument dependency traversal now memoizes subtree depth, preventing repeated traversal of shared premise graphs.
changes: Use replay in the external Java caller and retain stderr before checking its exit status.
Reserve breadth slots, preserve deterministic issue creation order, copy unresolved predecessor issues and require their resolution for supersession.
regression: Full old/new suite including minority family slot and inherited uncertainty tests.
Repeat the real retained 751-case Java repair demonstration, separate Java host, archive and source invalidation checks.
Run actual browser and isolated wheel installation after the demonstration passes.

content.summary: The second P4 run passed 203 tests and the complete Java demonstration but found real mobile overflow. Executed the layout repair and closed additional schema-to-runtime review gaps before repeating final acceptance.
findings: Long immutable IDs and default quotation margins overflowed a 390-pixel screen; the browser retained a screenshot of the failure.
The runtime could mark source coverage complete for an unreviewed retained-source inventory, contrary to the design's cross-record checks.
Adjudicated issues referenced decision IDs directly instead of validated evidence linked to those decisions.
Successors preserved root identities but needed to retain their local root/parent context too.
changes: Wrap long identifiers, reduce mobile quotation margins and capture the mobile screen at its top.
Add authenticated exact-source inventory review and require it for retained-source coverage readiness.
Persist HUMAN_ADJUDICATION evidence and validate evidence authority/source/content during report reconciliation.
Carry complete unresolved issue ancestor chains into successors, with fresh unresolved state and scoped run identities.
Regenerate the actual OpenAPI before its stability check in P4.
regression: Retained-source inventory cannot become complete through author assertion.
Adjudication evidence resolves to the exact authenticated decision and survives report validation.
Repeat all regressions, Java host/751 cases, browser and offline package checks.
